description: Open the Stripe billing portal of the caller's organization, and return its page for the person to open. Only organization owners and admins may call it, and an organization that has never bought credits returns a tool error. Needs a credential.
name: open_billing_portal

url.description: The Stripe page for the person to open in a browser and finish there. Stripe expires it, so call again for a fresh one.

title: Open billing portal
